She has just closed a locker and pauses with her weight settled evenly through both feet. Her face turns three-quarters toward the photographer, a quiet, softly attentive gaze and relaxed lips giving the practical pause a little intimacy. The reference informs her visible facial appearance and chin-length dark bob with wispy fringe. She wears a muted sage silk jeogori with a white dongjeong strip following the overlapping neckline, cream goreum tied at the chest with its two ribbon tails distinct, and an ink-blue chima descending in broad vertical pleats. The jeogori sits above the chima, its short hem visibly overlapping the skirt's high waist. A norigae hangs from the goreum knot at her right-front chest: its suspension cord, decorative knot, oval pendant and tassel form a readable descending chain. The pendant's pale-green oval stone sits inside a continuous silver bezel rim; a separate small silver bail connects the pendant's upper edge to that suspension cord. Her left hand holds a compact hard case by its handle low beside her left thigh; her right arm rests clear of the norigae, with relaxed fingers below the skirt waist. Warm ceiling light bars and cool skylight pick out cloth folds and small metal edges; recently shut locker doors repeat behind her. Frame from head to mid-calf at chest height, a nearly frontal view with mild three-quarter turn, keeping the collar, tie, ornament and layer junction large and readable. Natural facial texture, silk grain, and soft contact shadows organize the frame around her presence first, the garment construction second, and the modern setting third.
